q1.question: How quickly can I get started?
q1.answer: You can have a fully functional React TypeScript application running in under 5 minutes. Simply clone the repository, install dependencies, and start developing.

q2.question: What makes this boilerplate different?
q2.answer: Our boilerplate includes everything you need: TypeScript, Redux, internationalization, dark mode, and modern tooling. No need to configure anything from scratch.

q3.question: Is there support for mobile development?
q3.answer: Yes! The boilerplate is fully responsive and works great on mobile devices. All components are built with mobile-first design principles.

q4.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
q4.answer: Absolutely! This boilerplate is open source and free to use for both personal and commercial projects. We only ask that you credit us if you find it helpful.
